decisions.reason: Changing the Kajabi account used for the work does not change the duplicate page's requirement to omit the pricing section.
The workspace correction does not change the monthly marker text, typography, or coverage.
The updated page must still be duplicated at the specified time; the account in which work occurs is governed separately by the source Requirement.
Using the correct Kajabi account does not alter the required panel count, removed panel, or side-space layout rule.
The account correction does not change which Q&A box must be absent.
The source decision does not change the secondary control's label or required coverage.
The account used for editing does not change the control's placement below the primary button.
The workspace correction does not alter the control's wrapper or visual-style requirements.
The source changes only the workspace target and leaves the top block's visual layout expectations unchanged.
The requirement to remove the bonus section remains unchanged regardless of the corrected Kajabi account.
The workspace correction does not modify the instructor section's alignment expectation.
Using the correct account does not change the required top-section video replacement or playback behavior.
